description: NIBIO, the Norwegian Institute of Bioeconomy Research, runs a download service for its map datasets that are not distributed through Geonorge, the national geodata portal. The service read on 2026-09-28 lets users pick one dataset at a time, a geographic area, a file format and a coordinate system; some datasets are ready-made files for direct download, others are generated on order and sent by e-mail, and some require login and are marked in red in the list; licence and access terms are described on a linked NIBIO page. NIBIO's map data cover land resources such as land cover, agricultural and forest land and soils. Coverage is Norway. Access is free, with login for some datasets; the licence page was not read. Caveats: the dataset list loads in the service and was not enumerated, and many NIBIO layers are on Geonorge instead. It supports land cover and soil context for hazard exposure and adaptation studies of Norwegian roads, railways and power lines, such as landslide and flood susceptibility. No related NIBIO record is catalogued.
